mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_oper_log (oper_user_id, oper_username, oper_nickname, module_name, oper_title, oper_type, request_url, request_method, ip_address, browser, os, location, oper_param, oper_result, cost_time, status, error_msg, delete_flag, create_time) VALUES (#{operUserId}, #{operUsername}, #{operNickname}, #{moduleName}, #{operTitle}, #{operType}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestMethod}, #{ipAddress}, #{browser}, #{os}, #{location}, #{operParam}, #{operResult}, #{costTime}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, oper_user_id, oper_username, oper_nickname, module_name, oper_title, oper_type, request_url, request_method, ip_address, browser, os, location, oper_param, oper_result, cost_time, status, error_msg, create_time FROM sys_oper_log WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
